text:
emily: Heads up — after promoting AWQ act-quant group_size=48 for the 7B bring-up on canary, we're seeing a reproducible decoding drift vs FP16 baseline. quick numbers: eval perp delta +0.8, top-1 token KL spikes on some prompts. can reproduce locally on staging with same seed.
aj: ack. any sample outputs and a short log snippet?
emily: paste below — cleaned. noticed divergences in nouns/years and some confident hallucinations.
```
Serving log snippet (staging):
[2026-03-19T12:14:03Z] req 0x1a2 decode mismatch: kv_hits=0 tail-ms=21
Prompt: "Summarize the 1987 banking reforms in one paragraph"
FP16: "In 1987 the reforms consolidated regional banks..."
AWQ (actq, gsz=48): "In 1993 a major banking overhaul centralized..."  <-- wrong year, confident
Eval perp: FP16=12.3, AWQ-g48=13.1
```

aj: interesting. did we also change activation-quant buckets or only group_size?
emily: only group_size and a tiny lr tweak on the calibration step (0.1 -> 0.08).
devin: two quick hypotheses: 1) act-quant bucketization at gsz=48 increases per-group activation clipping leading to distribution shift; 2) calibration dataset sampling didn't cover the rare-year tokens so bias crept in.
sophia: can you run an actq-only sweep (gsz=32,48) with the original calibration seed please? also compare with gptq baseline.
emily: started an automated bisect job:
```
./awq_bisect.sh --model redwood/gpt-7b --variants "gsz=16,32,48,64" --seed 42 --eval /data/evals/temporal_holdout.jsonl --compare fp16
```
job id: awq-bisect-2965432
matt: ops-bot says canary traffic is low but present — would recommend pausing promotion until we have the bisect results. @ops-bot can you throttle canary to 0 for this model?
ops-bot: Canary throttled to 0% for redwood/gpt-7b-awq-g48 by request (emily). audit id: ctn-20260319-01 :thumbsup:
emily: also ran a small sample-set of 200 prompts comparing gsz=32 vs gsz=48 vs fp16. gsz=32 matches fp16 much closer. seems like instability threshold somewhere between 32 and 48.
devin: if gsz=32 is ok, plan: revert canary -> gsz=32, keep gsz=48 in experimental pool, run longer evals (N=5 seeds) and collect token-level KL / entropy traces.
sophia: add model-level flags to log first-100 token probs for failing prompts only (saves bandwidth). put those traces in /mnt/awq-traces/2965432100/
emily: noted. i'm attaching a tiny repro harness in the thread:
```
# minimal repro (python)
from redwood_infra.eval import Runner
r = Runner(model="redwood/gpt-7b-awq", group_size=48, actq=True, seed=42)
print(r.run_single("List the winners of the 1992 election"))
```

aj: good. devin can you lead the calibration sweep tomorrow morning? i'll own the rollout rollback and monitoring dashboards.
devin: yep. i'll also run a quick numeric debug to print activation histograms across group boundaries; that should show whether clipping is the issue.
emily: thanks — action items: 1) rollback canary -> gsz=32 (matt/aj), 2) run bisect/sweep with multiple seeds (emily/devin), 3) collect token-prob traces for mismatch prompts (sophia), 4) re-evaluate calibration pipeline sampling (emily).
matt: rollback scheduled in 5m. posting post-rollback metrics in ~30m.
ops-bot: Deployment event: rollback redwood/gpt-7b-awq gsz=48 -> gsz=32 (triggered by matt). event id: deploy-2965432330
emily: thanks everyone. keeping the thread for logs and final bakeoff summary. :memo:
